name: cellA_k31
about: Kimi-K3.1-Pro on 8 MI355X: TP8 + DCP8, ONE DP rank, bf16 KV, block 128, max-num-seqs 64, max len 1048576, no speculative decode, KDA recurrent state with a checkpoint every 8192 tokens: a prefix hit lands on a checkpoint boundary only (prefix_unit 8192) (#752; ~/agent_scratch/752/kimi/env_k31.sh). Rungs: ATOM's default capture sizes up to 64; max-num-batched-tokens and the prefill chunk at ATOM's 16384. One DP rank: rule 2.4.6 as for M3.1. tp 8 and dcp 8, and prefix_unit the state checkpoint interval 8192, are what `deploy.from_record` reads off a K3.1 record (the simulated DCP8 smoke, pit2-p03-g08 /var/tmp/perzhang_compass/p752/kimi/smoke_sim_dcp8, states them). kv_tokens is a PLACEHOLDER (#752: the pool holds about three 940k-token requests) until a real smoke record's run.json replaces it (`gen_v1.py --record`). The prefill's KDA state columns (752-kimi: kda_seqs, kda_saves, kda_forks, kda_moves, kda_pad_blocks) are a variant this tree's backend does not count: they report an error until that tree lands and the rehearsal's views carry KDA counts. Decode variant `rows`: the per-sequence, context-independent cost DCP's exchange adds at each full-attention layer (provisional column). The KDA layers carry no context term; `context` stands for the 24 full-attention layers. Dry run: waits for a law fitted on the smoke record.
